verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents per-item disposal choices: from the app or web portal a user can request that the operator open and scan a letter, forward mail or a package, or securely shred it. On-request shredding is clearly a documented action, but nothing in the evidence describes storage windows or retention periods, and nothing confirms that a shred has been completed. missing for 10: documented storage/retention windows, shred confirmation (e.g. certificate or notification), independent or hands-on corroboration.
